functions.name: core_thread_start
functions.brief: Start Thread: bring up the radio and OpenThread, then join (or form) the network from config.json.
functions.return_desc: 0 on success (also when Thread is already running), or a negative CORE_THREAD_ERR_* code.

functions.name: core_thread_process
functions.brief: Run Thread: radio events, OpenThread timers and tasks, received datagrams.

functions.name: core_thread_role
functions.brief: The device's current Thread role.
functions.return_desc: CORE_THREAD_DISABLED before core_thread_start(), else the role.

functions.name: core_thread_on_role_change
functions.brief: Register a callback for role changes (detached, child, router, leader).

params.name: cb
params.description: Called with the new role from core_thread_process(); NULL to remove.

params.name: ctx
params.description: Passed back to cb; may be NULL.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_open
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_open(uint16_t port, core_thread_udp_rx_cb rx_cb, void * ctx)
functions.brief: Open a UDP socket bound to a port and receive datagrams sent to it.

params.name: rx_cb
params.description: Called with each datagram received on the port (one core_thread_udp_packet_t); may be NULL to only send.

params.name: ctx
params.description: Passed back to rx_cb; may be NULL.

functions.return_desc: 0 on success, CORE_THREAD_ERR_FULL when all sockets are taken, or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_send
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_send(const uint8_t addr6[16], uint16_t port, const void * buf, uint16_t len)
functions.brief: Send a UDP datagram to an IPv6 address on the Thread network.

params.name: addr6
params.description: Destination IPv6 address, 16 bytes in network order.

functions.return_desc: 0 when queued, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE when not attached, or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_broadcast
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_broadcast(uint16_t port, const void * buf, uint16_t len)
functions.brief: Send a UDP datagram to every node on the Thread network (ff03::1, realm-local all-nodes).
functions.return_desc: 0 when queued, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE when not attached, or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_rloc16
functions.brief: The device's RLOC16 (its short address in the mesh; changes with the role).
functions.return_desc: The RLOC16, or 0xFFFE when not attached.

functions.name: core_thread_ext_addr
functions.brief: Copy the device's IEEE 802.15.4 extended address (8 bytes).

functions.name: core_thread_partition_id
functions.brief: The ID of the Thread partition the device belongs to.
functions.return_desc: The partition ID, or 0 when not attached.

functions.name: core_thread_neighbor_count
functions.brief: Number of neighbours in the device's neighbour table (routers and children it hears).

functions.name: core_thread_parent_rssi
functions.brief: Average RSSI of frames from the parent, when the device is a child.
functions.return_desc: RSSI in dBm, or 127 when there is no parent (not a child).

functions.name: core_thread_last_error
functions.brief: The last error OpenThread reported to this API (an otError value; 0 = none).

functions.name: core_thread_instance
functions.brief: The OpenThread instance, for C code that calls the OpenThread API directly.
functions.return_desc: An otInstance pointer (as void*), or NULL before core_thread_start().

functions.name: core_thread_get_network
functions.brief: Read the network the device is set to (its active dataset), without the network key.

params.name: out
params.description: Receives channel, PAN ID, ext PAN ID, mesh-local prefix, name and timestamp; network_key is all zeros.

functions.return_desc: 0 on success, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE before core_thread_start(), or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_set_enabled
functions.brief: Stop or restart Thread: leave the network (detach, radio idle for Thread) or attach again.

params.name: on
params.description: 0 to stop (the role becomes CORE_THREAD_DISABLED), 1 to start again.

functions.return_desc: 0 on success, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE before core_thread_start(), or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_set_dataset
functions.brief: Move the device to another Thread network and store it, so it wins over config.json from now on.

params.name: ds
params.description: The new network: channel 11-26, PAN ID 0x0000-0xFFFE, a 1-16 byte name, key, ext PAN ID, mesh-local prefix.

functions.return_desc: 0 on success, CORE_THREAD_ERR_ARG for a bad dataset, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE before core_thread_start(), CORE_THREAD_ERR_UNSUPPORTED without "provisioning" in config.json, or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_factory_reset
functions.brief: Forget the stored (provisioned) network and return to config.json's, then attach again.
functions.return_desc: 0 on success, CORE_THREAD_ERR_STATE before core_thread_start(), CORE_THREAD_ERR_UNSUPPORTED without "provisioning" in config.json, or another negative code.

functions.name: core_thread_is_provisioned
functions.brief: Is the current network a stored (provisioned) one rather than config.json's factory default?
functions.return_desc: 1 when a provisioned network is in use, 0 when it is config.json's (always 0 before core_thread_start() and in builds without "provisioning").

functions.name: core_thread_prov_allow_write
functions.brief: Hook: may a BLE client change the network now? Override to gate the provisioning service.
functions.return_desc: Nonzero to accept writes to the BLE provisioning service, 0 to refuse them (THREAD_PROV_ERR_DENIED). The SDK's default (a weak function) returns 1: open writes.

types.name: core_thread_role_t
types.brief: Device role (the values of OpenThread's otDeviceRole).

members.name: CORE_THREAD_DETACHED
members.description: Running, not attached to a network (searching)

members.name: CORE_THREAD_CHILD
members.description: Attached as a child of a router

members.name: CORE_THREAD_LEADER
members.description: The leader (a router that also manages the partition)

types.name: core_thread_role_cb
types.brief: Role-change callback: the new role. Runs from core_thread_process().

types.name: core_thread_udp_packet_t
types.brief: A received UDP datagram, as handed to a core_thread_udp_rx_cb. One struct instead of separate arguments on purpose: the old (data, len, src, port, ctx) form had two pointer and two uint16_t parameters, so a callback with them in the wrong order compiled silently and read the sender's address as the payload. Valid only during the callback: copy what you keep.

types.name: core_thread_udp_rx_cb
types.brief: UDP receive callback. Runs from core_thread_process(). Reply with core_thread_udp_send(pkt->src, pkt->src_port, ...).

types.name: core_thread_dataset_t
types.brief: A Thread network: the operational dataset fields config.json sets. Byte strings are in the order they are written down (an ext PAN ID of dead00beef00cafe is { 0xde, 0xad, 0x00, 0xbe, 0xef, 0x00, 0xca, 0xfe }).

fields.name: mesh_local_prefix
fields.description: Mesh-local prefix: the first 8 bytes of the /64 (fdde:ad00:beef:0:: is fd de ad 00 be ef 00 00)

fields.name: active_timestamp
fields.description: Active Timestamp, seconds; 0 means 1, the value config.json networks use

constants.name: CORE_THREAD_ERR_UNSUPPORTED
constants.description: Not in this build: needs config.json "thread": {"provisioning": true}

constants.name: CORE_THREAD_UDP_MAX_PAYLOAD
constants.description: Received datagrams are cut to this many bytes
